description_en: Grants a license to devices under a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品下设备授权License
name: BindLicenseDevice

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: 480P, 720P
parameters.help_zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：480P、720P
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the devices to be authorized belong.

You can view the information of all products under the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
待授权设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of devices to be authorized with a license. You must specify the IotId of each device.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the IotId of all devices under a specified product
parameters.help_zh:
待授权License的设备列表，需传入设备对应的IotId。

您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html，查询指定产品下所有设备的**IotId**
parameters.name: iot_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The list of devices to be authorized with a license. You must specify the DeviceName of each device.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the DeviceName of all devices under a specified product
parameters.help_zh:
待授权License的设备列表，需传入设备对应的DeviceName。

您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html，查询指定产品下所有设备的**DeviceName**
parameters.name: device_name_list

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see the Error codes section below
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见本文下方_错误码_

CheckProgressId.description_en: The unique ID used to query the progress of batch device authorization
CheckProgressId.description_zh: 查询批量授权设备进度的唯一ID

FailSum.description_en: The number of devices that failed to be authorized with a license

Progress.description_en: The progress percentage of authorizing licenses to devices in batches. Valid values: 1 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 为批量设备授权License的进度百分比，即取值范围为1~100

ResultCsvFile.description_en: The URL of the file that contains the devices that failed to be authorized after the license authorization is complete
ResultCsvFile.description_zh: 授权License完成后，授权失败设备文件的URL

SuccessSum.description_en: The number of devices that were successfully authorized with a license

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
